description: A Python class 'DotpromptManager' that extends custom prompt management interfaces to support .prompt files within the LiteLLM ecosystem. It provides functionality for loading, rendering, and converting prompt templates, especially those stored as files, into chat messages, and integrates with the overall prompt management system.

classes.name: DotpromptManager
classes.description: A class that manages prompts stored in '.prompt' files, enabling integration with LiteLLM models and tasks, supporting prompt rendering, conversion, and prompt-related operations.
